==Bundles==
Calcite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Calcite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Calcite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt182.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Calcite is not used in any [[quests]].
